extracted.intended_audience: researchers and research institutions seeking funding from the Austrian Science Fund (FWF), including international applicants
extracted.subtask_description: A landing/overview page for the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) that directs prospective applicants and stakeholders to funding programs, application steps, open science, evaluation, and transparency resources. It summarizes focal areas and links to program-specific guidance and the application portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for pioneering researchers / basic research
rubrics_metrics.description: The FWF funds thousands of outstanding researchers and their ideas at universities and other research institutions on the basis of an international peer review process. Basic research takes time, but it opens up entirely new horizons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises funding for pioneering, basic research that may be long-term and exploratory; supports 'researchers on their roads to discovery' and values insights as capital for future generations.

rubrics_metrics.name: International peer review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding decisions are made on the basis of an international peer review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies submissions are evaluated against international scientific standards by external experts; applicants should expect peer-review criteria and processes consistent with international norms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding program portfolio
rubrics_metrics.description: The FWF provides a portfolio of funding programmes (FWF’s Funding Programs) offering a wide range of options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the programme portfolio to identify the scheme that fits their career stage/project type; the homepage links to detailed programme pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Step-by-step application guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a 'Step by Step' resource to find out more about the steps to successful funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotes following prescribed application steps and procedures; applicants are directed to the application portal (elane) to submit proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application portal (elane)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are expected to use the FWF application portal 'elane' to submit proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical requirement for submission—use the designated online system and follow its formats and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency and Research Radar
rubrics_metrics.description: The FWF publishes data on its funding programs, approved projects, and individuals on the Dashboard and the Research Radar page to ensure transparency and make it available for further use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and stakeholders can search through funded projects and use the open data interface; transparency practices may inform evaluation and benchmarking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Open Science refers to open and collaborative science practices that enable open access to scientific knowledge and research processes, resulting in the greatest possible transparency and reusability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FWF endorses open science principles—applicants should plan for openness (e.g., data sharing, open access) where applicable and follow related policies linked from the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluations and quality assurance
rubrics_metrics.description: The FWF has a section on 'Evaluations and Quality Assurance'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that funded programmes and processes undergo evaluation to maintain standards; applicants and grant managers should expect mechanisms for quality assessment and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: The FWF maintains a focus on 'Academic Integrity'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and funded researchers must comply with standards of research integrity (e.g., honest reporting, avoidance of misconduct); further details are available on the linked page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equal opportunities and diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: The FWF has a focus area on 'Equal Opportunities and Diversity'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fund promotes equal opportunities and diversity considerations in its programmes; applicants should be aware of related policies or support measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science communication
rubrics_metrics.description: The FWF supports 'Science Communication' and runs the scilog magazine to present projects, video portraits, and interviews with FWF-funded researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages applicants to consider dissemination and public communication of research results; the FWF highlights outreach and visibility as valued activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Philanthropy / alpha+ Foundation
rubrics_metrics.description: Through the alpha+ Foundation, the FWF offers philanthropically inclined individuals and organisations the opportunity to support excellent researchers throughout Austria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternative funding/support channel—stakeholders can use philanthropic instruments to back research; applicants may be eligible for or benefit from such initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key focal areas and schemes (e.g., excellent=austria, Clusters of Excellence, emerging fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: FWF highlights key focal areas and initiatives like excellent=austria, Clusters of Excellence, and funding for emerging fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should identify targeted initiatives matching their research (e.g., collaborative cluster programs, thematic calls) and consult specific calls for criteria and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: News and results reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: The site publishes news items such as 'FWF Approves 178 new Research Projects' and reports on evaluations and program outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrates the fund’s recent activity and outcomes; useful for applicants to understand funding trends and priorities.
